name: Blessing of Dúir [Ogham]
body:
The mighty oak represents your inner strength and ability to weather the strongest of storms through the dúir ogham. It grants you an inner strength to resolve conflict with enduring stoicism.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use your Constitution modifier in place of Charisma when making Diplomacy and Intimidate skill checks or any Charisma ability check that does not involve deception, representing the strength of your character granted by your strong demeanor. For every ogham feat you possess beyond this one, you gain a +1 bonus to the aforementioned skill check as well.
